Hi all, 
I use GGIR with the verisense-step-algorithm as external function. The expected sample rate of the step algorithm is 15Hz and the sample rate of my data is 50Hz. It is written in the vignette, that if the sample frequencies do not match, the signal is resampled. Which function is used for this resampling?

Kind regards and thank you for your answer!
Riccardo
